up: Show the IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human C-C chemokine receptor type 2. List each compound's ChEMBL ID, SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, and target name and organism. Only include compounds that have a SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'C-C chemokine receptor type 2'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
